ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR39] Requires Remarketing Required on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for ALM Business Unit deals. Simplified per IRM feedback. Uses ALM_BU__c (not Business_Unit__c).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
ALM_BU__c = TRUE,
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(Remarketing_Required__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Remarketing Required is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
